key_terms.سَمْكها: Height or thickness of the sky

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God raised the sky and proportioned it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the expansion and structural perfection of the universe, reflecting the divine attribute of *Al-Musawwir* (The Shaper). It underscores the cosmic order (*Nazm*) established by God, serving as a sign for those who reflect on the harmony between the physical cosmos and spiritual truth.
